title: Can we Debias Social Stereotypes in AI-Generated Images? Examining Text-to-Image Outputs and User Perceptions
reasoning: The paper focuses on social stereotypes (race, gender, occupation, geocultural) and their mitigation in text-to-image models using the proposed Social Stereotype Index (SSI). While it discusses 'ethical representation' and contains a standard ethics and reflexivity statement, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, theology, or specific moral/ethical frameworks.
